description:
**The Role**

We are looking for a Mid-Level AI Engineer (3–6 years experience) to build the trust and verification layer for AI shopping agents. You will integrate directly into Anthropic's open-source Claude Commerce Agents blueprint and the surrounding Claude tooling, making the result straightforward and modular for merchant and client engineering teams to adopt.

You will work as part of a collaborative delivery team alongside our solution architects and full-stack engineers, partnering closely with client engineering teams. The work spans production Python services, agent runtimes, MCP servers, API security, and evaluation of agent behavior.

You should be comfortable working from written epics and acceptance criteria, reading unfamiliar codebases quickly, and delivering high-quality software with clear technical direction from senior architects. Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment about API reliability and security failure modes matter more here than any single niche framework.

**What You'll Do**

*These are the focus areas for your first 90 days, not an exhaustive list. Agentic commerce is moving quickly, and priorities may shift within the mission as new capabilities and protocols emerge*
.

* **Runtime Setup:**
  Stand up the blueprint's verticals across Claude runtimes (Messages API, Agent SDK, and Managed Agents), run its test and verification suites, and maintain compatibility with our fork.
* **Trust Integration:**
  Implement the trust integration for the blueprint's StorefrontBackend and MerchantBackend. This includes binding identity at session start, executing in-path trust checks on cart and checkout hooks, mapping decisions to the blueprint's native tool-result semantics (Unavailable and domain errors), setting fail-open/fail-closed policies per hook, logging decisions without PII, and reporting outcomes.
* **MCP Gateway:**
  Build and test the storefront MCP server path for Managed Agents behind an authenticating gateway, supporting vault-credential and signed-claim identity options.
* **MCP Server and Skill:**
  Build an MCP server exposing advisory and catalog tools, plus a companion skill for the blueprint's commerce-builder Claude Code plugin.
* **Integration Guide:**
  Author the merchant integration guide and measure merchant effort (files, lines, prompt bytes, gates, and time to first verified session) as an acceptance metric.
* **Token & Identity Integration:**
  Integrate OAuth token exchange and authentication flows against enterprise identity providers, working alongside Solution Architects to ensure session trust signals use audience-scoped downstream tokens without insecure passthrough.
* **AWS Runtime:**
  Embed trust verification in agent runtimes hosted on AWS (such as Bedrock-hosted worker agents, Lambda, or ECS services), keeping enforcement logic in code outside the model.
* **Evaluation Harness:**
  Build and maintain an evaluation harness for shopping agents with scenario sets, tool-call and purchase-correctness metrics, and adversarial cases (prompt injection, wrong item, over-spend) with reproducible runs in CI.
* **Backend Services:**
  Build robust backend services with typed APIs, structured audit logging, permissible-use checks, and idempotent operations.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience building production Python microservices for modern SaaS, e-commerce, or technology backends.
* Strong Python fundamentals: async (asyncio), typed code (mypy/pydantic), pytest, and ruff. Comfortable subclassing abstract backends and mapping exceptions to structured results.
* API security fundamentals: OAuth 2.0 authorization flows, JWT issuance and verification, token lifecycle management, and secrets handling.
* Microservices experience: service-to-service authentication, structured error and result handling across service boundaries, and the ability to call external risk APIs inside a latency budget while reasoning about fail-open versus fail-closed behavior.
* LLM Tool-Calling Fundamentals: Experience integrating LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, Bedrock) with structured tool calling / function calling and agentic workflows.
* Ability to read an unfamiliar codebase quickly, trace execution paths, and debug issues systematically.
* Ability to work from written acceptance criteria, deliver with architectural guidance, and communicate progress and risks clearly in writing and in demos.
* Strong collaborator who can partner effectively with client engineers and internal cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with or interest in OAuth token exchange (RFC 8693) and secure delegation patterns (audience scoping, confused deputy prevention).
* Production AWS experience (Lambda or ECS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch).
* Hands-on experience shipping tool-using LLM agents on the Claude Messages API or Agent SDK, with familiarity with prompt caching.
* Built or integrated Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers (streamable HTTP) with authentication layers.
* Built or extended an automated LLM evaluation or regression harness in CI/CD.

Draft and maintain clear health, risk and next-step entries aligned to the review cadence.
  
  
**Data and source management:**
Extract, reconcile and quality-check information from CRM, BI, usage, support, training, version and survey sources.
  
  
**Cross-functional collaboration:**
Work with account teams, Customer Success Operations and technical data owners to validate context and recommendations.
  
  
**Documentation and controls:**
Maintain source links, definitions, standard operating procedures, quality checks, templates and cadence calendars.
  
  
**Automation and enablement:**
Help translate review and risk-reporting processes into scalable workflows while preserving quality and traceability.

3–5 years in Customer Success operations, customer-health or renewal analytics, business analytics, data analytics or comparable work.

Advanced Excel skills and demonstrated experience handling and reconciling multiple data sources.
  
  
**Reporting tools:**
Hands-on experience with a business intelligence tool such as Power BI and experience working with CRM data.
  
  
**Business judgement:**
Working understanding of customer health, adoption, churn or attrition risk, renewals and Customer Success operating models.
  
  
**Communication:**
Ability to convert complex evidence into concise, defensible narratives and practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
  
  
**Operating discipline:**
High attention to detail, source traceability, documentation quality and recurring delivery commitments.

**Customer Success platforms:**
Experience with Gainsight or a comparable platform.

Exposure to Snowflake or other data-warehouse extracts, Power Query, SQL, scripting or workflow automation.

Experience developing health scores, early-warning models, renewal dashboards or executive account reviews.

Experience in B2B enterprise software or industrial software.

Account reviews, risk refreshes, reports and CRM narratives are accurate and completed against an agreed operating calendar.

Account teams can understand the evidence, validate the context and act on the recommendations.
  
  
**Data integrity:**
Material data gaps are visible and tracked rather than being misclassified as customer risk.
  
  
**Scalability:**
Processes and controls are documented and progressively standardised or automated without reducing quality.

This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across multiple regions and requires effective collaboration in a globally distributed environment. The role enables account teams with structured insights or scaled engagement and does not replace commercial account ownership.

Candidates should have the ability to develop, deploy, and optimize AI solutions in real-world production environments rather than having experience limited to academic projects or theoretical implementations.

description:

**About the Role:**
As Business Analyst you are the bridge between business stakeholders and Avaloq delivery squads: you elicit and challenge requirements, shape them into Avaloq-executable functional designs, and stay accountable for them through build, SIT, UAT and go-live.
  
  
This is a hands-on delivery role on large, multi-workstream Avaloq programmes. You will own the requirement thread end to end — from a business pain point in the front office to a signed-off UAT result in production.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of Business Analysis experience, of which at least 3 years in banking or financial services.

* Demonstrated delivery on at least one large-scale core banking transformation programme, end to end.

* Proven authorship of BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process maps and traceability matrices.
* Experience in both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.
* Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to write specifications that a developer can build from without further explanation.

**TOOLS & TECHNICAL SKILLS**
Avaloq Banking Suite (functional)
  
  

* Requirements management
* BPMN / Visio process modelling
* JIRA & Azure DevOps
* Confluence

**Job Responsibilities**

2. Process Analysis & Avaloq Solution Design3. Stakeholder Engagement & Governance4. Agile Delivery & Backlog Management5. Delivery Assurance, Data Validation & Go-Live

title: Security Governance Business Analyst – Senior
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Security Governance Business Analyst to support infrastructure access governance, security controls and compliance initiatives.

The role will focus on defining and strengthening governance frameworks for infrastructure access, establishing role ownership and accountability, improving access visibility, supporting access certification and ensuring compliance with Segregation of Duties (SoD) and least-privilege requirements.

The successful candidate will work with security, infrastructure, IAM, risk and compliance stakeholders to translate governance requirements into practical processes, controls and reporting frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Infrastructure Access Governance**

* Support the development and implementation of a standardised infrastructure access governance framework.
* Define governance requirements for infrastructure access based on job functions, responsibilities and least-privilege principles.
* Establish role ownership, accountability and access approval structures.
* Work with infrastructure and security teams to define access governance policies and standards.
* Ensure consistency in access management processes across infrastructure environments.

**2. Security Governance & Compliance**

* Define and support governance processes covering access reviews, access certifications and exception management.
* Establish and monitor Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls.
* Identify, assess and manage toxic access combinations.
* Support the development and maintenance of security control frameworks.
* Track governance exceptions, control gaps and remediation actions.
* Ensure access governance processes remain aligned with internal policies and compliance requirements.

**3. Access Visibility & Reporting**

* Establish reporting requirements to provide visibility into infrastructure access and privileged entitlements.
* Define reporting metrics covering who has access to what, role ownership and access certifications.
* Work with technical teams to develop access governance dashboards and reports.
* Analyse access-related data to identify governance gaps and potential risks.
* Prepare management reports and support audit evidence requirements.

**4. Role Governance & Rationalisation**

* Work with RBAC and role mining teams to define standardised infrastructure roles.
* Establish processes for role ownership, role approvals and periodic role reviews.
* Support entitlement rationalisation and reduction of excessive privileges.
* Ensure role definitions are aligned with business responsibilities and least-privilege requirements.
* Maintain governance documentation, role matrices and control records.

**5. Privileged Access Security**

* Support governance of privileged access and elevated entitlements.
* Ensure privileged access controls align with the broader RBAC framework.
* Work with PAM teams on CyberArk EPM governance, monitoring and policy enforcement.
* Define governance requirements for privileged access reviews and exception handling.

**6. Automation & Zero Trust Enablement**

* Identify opportunities to automate access governance and lifecycle management processes.
* Define business requirements for Joiner, Mover and Leaver (JML) workflows.
* Work with IAM and technical teams to establish workflow-based access approvals and controls.
* Support policy-based access management and continuous governance initiatives.
* Contribute to the organisation's Zero Trust security objectives.

Required Skills & Experience

* Strong experience as a Business Analyst in Information Security, IAM, IT Security Governance or Infrastructure Security.
* Good understanding of RBAC, infrastructure access governance and least-privilege principles.
* Experience defining security governance frameworks, policies, processes and controls.
* Knowledge of Segregation of Duties (SoD), toxic combinations and access certification.
* Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional requirements and process documentation.
* Experience working with security, infrastructure, IAM, risk and compliance stakeholders.
* Understanding of privileged access governance and PAM concepts.
* Experience with governance reporting, access reviews, audit readiness and exception management.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical and documentation skills.

Preferred Skills

* Exposure to CyberArk EPM or other Privileged Access Management solutions.
* Knowledge of IAM platforms, RBAC tools and access governance solutions.
* Experience with JML lifecycle management and workflow automation.
* Understanding of continuous access governance and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience working in large enterprise or financial services environments.

* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.
